From soaring investments to corporate champions, discover how the region is greening its future. Yet, amidst the growth, challenges loom—like balancing returns with impact. Join us as we navigate the highs, lows, and regulatory twists shaping SEA's climate revolution. ‍ Climate tech investing is on the rise in Southeast Asia (SEA) . Southeast Asia Venture Capital News & Insight | Openspace Contact Investor Login Team Companies Strategies Responsibility Reports Careers Team Companies Strategies Responsibility Reports Contact Careers Investor Login Portfolio Company Feature: Sarisuki Jaclyn Seow February 28, 2023 Sarisuki is one of our portfolio companies from the Philippines, where they are disrupting the food supply chain by providing high quality products to consumers at more affordable pricing, serving as an end-to-end e-grocery platform in the country. ‍ Sarisuki adopts an agent model, where consumers are able to purchase fresh groceries from “community leaders” who purchase these products in bulk, a model that allows them to access supermarket quality products at wet market prices. Sarisuki’s business model also helps Filipinos earn a decent income easily, needing only a smartphone and an internet connection to be a community leader. ‍ With key urban areas in the Philippines facing high population density, growing disposable income and maturing digital connectivity, Sarisuki’s services has the potential to grow in time to come. ‍ RETURN TO INSIGHTS Sarisuki is one of our portfolio companies from the Philippines, where they are disrupting the food supply chain by providing high quality products to consumers at more affordable pricing, serving as an end-to-end e-grocery platform in the country. ‍
